caption: A person in a red life vest swims through churning white water rapids while a kayaker paddles alongside; spray covers the camera as the current pulls them downstream.
Two anglers sit in a moored rowing boat on a calm lake at sunset; nobody enters the water and the surface stays perfectly still.
A swimmer does laps in an indoor pool, flip-turning at the wall under bright ceiling lights while a coach watches from the deck.
A chef dices onions on a wooden board, slides them into a hot pan, and stirs the sizzling mixture with a wooden spoon.
A golden retriever chases a frisbee across a park lawn, leaps to catch it mid-air, and trots back to its owner.
A cyclist descends a mountain switchback at speed, leaning into each turn as pine trees blur past on either side.
A violinist rehearses on a dim concert stage; the bow moves across the strings while sheet music sits on a stand beside her.
Waves crash against a rocky shoreline as a storm rolls in; seabirds circle overhead and rain begins to streak the lens.
A toddler stacks coloured wooden blocks into a tower on a carpet, knocks it over, and laughs before starting again.
A barista pulls an espresso shot, steams milk in a metal pitcher, and pours a rosetta into a white ceramic cup.
A rafting crew paddles a yellow inflatable raft through white water rapids, shouting instructions as the raft drops over a ledge.
A skateboarder grinds a handrail outside a library, lands cleanly, and rolls away past a group of students.
A woman practises yoga on a wooden deck at sunrise, moving slowly from downward dog into a warrior pose.
A train pulls into a rural station platform; passengers with suitcases step down as the conductor signals from the last carriage.
A potter centres clay on a spinning wheel, opens the form with both thumbs, and pulls the walls of a bowl upward.
Firefighters in full gear direct a hose at a smoking warehouse roof while a ladder truck extends behind them.
A street musician plays saxophone under a subway archway; commuters slow down and a few drop coins into an open case.
A farmer drives a tractor along a ploughed field at dusk, gulls following the furrows behind the plough.
Children splash in the shallow end of an outdoor swimming pool on a hot afternoon while a lifeguard scans the water.
A climber chalks her hands and works up an overhanging indoor bouldering wall before dropping onto the crash mat.
A baker shapes sourdough loaves, scores each one with a blade, and slides them into a stone oven.
A soccer goalkeeper dives to parry a penalty kick, and the ball deflects off the post as the crowd rises.
A mechanic raises a car on a lift, removes a wheel with an impact wrench, and inspects the brake disc.
Kayakers navigate a narrow gorge of white water, one capsizing briefly before rolling upright and continuing downstream.
